people.name: Hananiah
people.line: A perfumer who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall

people.name: Harhaiah
people.line: A goldsmith whose son helped repair Jerusalem's wall.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Uzziel
people.line: Goldsmith who helped repair Jerusalem's wall

translations.web: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.
translations.bsb: Next to them, Uzziel son of Harhaiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs. And next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs. They fortified Jerusalem as far as the Broad Wall.
translations.kjv: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths. Next unto him also repaired Hananiah the son of one of the apothecaries, and they fortified Jerusalem unto the broad wall.
translations.asv: Next unto him repaired Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths. And next unto him repaired Hananiah one of the perfumers, and they fortified Jerusalem even unto the broad wall.
